map.由半衰期求衰变常数。: Find the decay constant from the half-life.
map.碳-14 半衰期 5730 年。: Carbon-14 has a half-life of 5730 years.
map.th 求衰变常数 λ。: half-life th, find the decay constant λ.
map.用于活度、年代等下游计算。: Used for downstream calculations of activity and age.
map.若 th=11460 年，则 λ 减半为 6.05×10⁻⁵ yr⁻¹。: If th = 11460 years, λ halves to 6.05×10⁻⁵ yr⁻¹.
map.yearly 与 per-second 的 λ 如何换算？: How do yearly and per-second λ convert?
map.差一个 365.25×24×3600 倍，仅时间单位不同，物理量一致。: They differ by a factor of 365.25 x 24 x 3600; only the time unit changes, the physical quantity is the same.
map.可以，对极短寿命（如 μs 级）λ 很大，表示极快衰变。: Yes. For extremely short lives such as the microsecond scale λ is large, meaning very fast decay.
